title: Power-Law Approach of the Stress-Energy Tensor to the Unruh State after Gravitational Collapse
summary: We establish the rate at which the renormalized stress--energy tensor of a massless minimally coupled scalar field in the in-vacuum state of a collapsing null-shell spacetime approaches the corresponding Unruh-state value. At finite exterior radius, we establish the upper bound \[ |Δ\langle T_{μν}\rangle|\leq C(r)\,t_s^{-3} \] from the Cauchy-surface decomposition of the Hadamard difference and the branch-cut structure of the retarded Green function.
